subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 13th day of Decimating the Moathouse and the Call to Nulb.
source_quote: Chapter 13 Decimating the Moathouse and the Call to Nulb

subject: gnoll count
fact: Eight Gnolls are allies of Lareth's via a local Gnoll King.
source_quote: a large group of eight Gnolls who were allies of Lareth's via a local Gnoll King

subject: bugbear count
fact: Six intelligent Bugbears guard the chamber.
source_quote: a chamber guarded by six intelligent Bugbears

subject: travel to Nulb
fact: The party must travel to the city of Nulb to infiltrate the Temple's operations there, disrupt their machinations, and identify who was truly in charge.
source_quote: the next step was vital: the party must travel to the city of Nulb to infiltrate the Temple's operations there, disrupt their machinations, and identify who was truly in charge

subject: moathouse clearance
fact: The party successfully cleared out the Moathouse operation.
source_quote: They had successfully cleared out the Moathouse operation

subject: magic items value
fact: A Mace of Smiting, magical Plate Mail (which no one could wear), and a Ring of Free Action were found.
source_quote: Magic Items: A Mace of Smiting, magical Plate Mail (which no one could wear), and a Ring of Free Action.

subject: wealth value
fact: A silver service set worth 2,000 GP, a fire opal necklace worth 3,500 GP, and various gems worth 800 GP were looted.
source_quote: Wealth: A silver service set worth 2,000 GP, a fire opal necklace worth 3,500 GP, and various gems (ungets) worth 800 GP.

subject: level up
fact: All four adventurers gained a level, increasing their power and acquiring new abilities, such as Sequoia's Uncanny Dodge.
source_quote: all four adventurers gained a level, increasing their power and acquiring new abilities, such as Sequoia's Uncanny Dodge

subject: payment for cleanup
fact: The party agreed to pay Thorne (Duke) a 50 GP fee for the clean-up job.
source_quote: agreeing to pay him a 50 GP fee for the clean-up job

subject: chest of rao possession
fact: The adventurers remain in possession of the invaluable Chest of Rao.
source_quote: still in possession of the invaluable Chest of Rao
